name: Survival Island (Hard)
description: The extreme variant of Survival Island, on the same engine and rules. The ship only starts passing on day 8 or 9, so the castaway must survive most of the 13 days before any rescue is possible. The weather is harsher (more storms and rain, colder nights), the spring only trickles (+60 water per drink), three of five berry bushes are poisonous (−30 health) so fishing and cooking matter, and the crew still needs a campfire burning the night before as proof of life. Staying alive requires a sheltered camp, a campfire kept fuelled and a steady food and water routine; rescue is possible but far from guaranteed.
hook: Thirteen harsh days: storms, a trickling spring, poison everywhere — and the ship does not come until day 8.
author: Gauntlet Core
